common.comingSoon: Coming soon. This part of Muvo arrives in a later version.

welcome.title: Welcome to Muvo
welcome.subtitle: Your CointMU wallet. Your keys stay on this phone.

create.title: Creating your wallet
create.progress: Generating your recovery phrase and keys. This can take a few seconds.
create.error: Couldn't create the wallet. Please try again.

backup.title: Your recovery phrase
backup.subtitle: Write these words down in order and keep them offline. Anyone who has them can take your funds, and nobody can recover them for you.

verify.title: Check your backup
verify.subtitle: Enter these words from your recovery phrase.
verify.incorrect: That word doesn't match. Check what you wrote down.

import.title: Import a wallet
import.invalidMnemonic: That isn't a valid 12- or 24-word recovery phrase.
import.invalidPrivateKey: That isn't a valid private key.
import.privateKeyWarningBody: A wallet imported from a private key has no recovery phrase. The key is stored only on this phone. If you lose the phone or reset the app without your own backup of the key, the funds are gone.
import.privateKeyAck: I have my own backup of this private key
import.error: Couldn't import the wallet. Please try again.

setPin.subtitle: You'll use it to unlock Muvo and approve transactions.
setPin.error: Couldn't save your PIN. Please try again.
setPin.biometricsBody: Use your fingerprint or face to unlock Muvo. Your PIN always works too.

recover.title: We couldn't read your wallet
recover.body: The wallet data on this device couldn't be read, so it was removed to keep you safe. Your funds are still on the CointMU network. Import your recovery phrase or private key to get access back.

lock.title: Enter your PIN
lock.lockedOut: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in {{time}}.
lock.resetHint: Forgot your PIN? You can reset this wallet and restore it with your recovery phrase.

reset.confirmBody: This deletes the wallet from this phone. Without your recovery phrase or private key, the funds are lost.

balance.label: Total balance
balance.error: Can't reach the CointMU network right now. Pull down to refresh or try again.

transactions.title: Recent activity
transactions.emptyHint: Transactions you send from Muvo appear here.

network.title: Network
network.subtitle: Which CointMU node Muvo talks to. Your keys never leave this phone; a node only sees your public address and the requests Muvo sends.
network.nodesFooter: Muvo only switches to a node that reports chain ID {{chainId}}.
network.refusedUnreachable: Couldn't reach that node. Muvo keeps using the current one.
network.refusedWrongChain: That node is on chain {{chainId}}, not CointMU ({{expected}}). Muvo keeps using the current one.
network.addHint: Use https://. Plain http:// is blocked in release builds.
network.invalidUrl: Enter an http:// or https:// URL.
network.alreadyListed: That node is already in the list.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.addHint: New accounts come from your recovery phrase, so it restores all of them.
accounts.privateKeyHint: This wallet was imported from a private key, so it has no recovery phrase to create more accounts from. To use several accounts, use a wallet with a recovery phrase.
accounts.addFailed: Couldn't add an account. Please try again.

security.title: Security
security.biometricsDesc: Fingerprint or face. Your PIN always works too.
security.biometricsUnavailable: No fingerprint or face is set up on this phone.
security.autoLockDesc: Lock Muvo after it has been in the background this long; you then need your PIN again.
security.recoveryPhraseDesc: The words that restore your wallet

changePin.title: Change PIN
changePin.currentSubtitle: Wrong attempts count toward the lockout.
changePin.newSubtitle: 6 digits. You'll use it to unlock Muvo and approve transactions.
changePin.error: Couldn't save the new PIN. Your old PIN still works. Please try again.

recoveryPhrase.title: Recovery phrase
recoveryPhrase.description: Your recovery phrase restores full access to this wallet.
recoveryPhrase.warning: Never share your recovery phrase. Anyone who has it can take full control of your wallet and steal all of your funds. Store it offline and never type it into a website.
recoveryPhrase.autoHide: It is also hidden when you leave this screen or Muvo goes to the background.
recoveryPhrase.privateKey: This wallet was imported from a private key, so it has no recovery phrase. Keep your own backup of the key: it is the only way to restore this wallet.

logout.title: Log out
logout.lockNowDesc: Lock Muvo until you enter your PIN. Nothing is deleted.
logout.removeDesc: Deletes the keys from this phone. You need your recovery phrase to get the wallet back.

removeWallet.title: Remove wallet
removeWallet.warningTitle: Make sure you have your recovery phrase
removeWallet.warning: This action is irreversible. If you have not backed up your recovery phrase or private key, your funds will be lost forever. CointMU cannot recover them for you.
removeWallet.description: This permanently removes all accounts and keys from this device. Your funds stay on the CointMU network; you can restore the wallet later with your recovery phrase or private key.
removeWallet.ack: I have my recovery phrase or private key written down
removeWallet.authSubtitle: to remove the wallet from this phone

about.title: About
about.reportIssueDesc: Send a bug report or feature request
about.licenseDesc: Open source under the MIT License

pinPrompt.error: Couldn't check the PIN. Please try again.
pinPrompt.mismatch: The PINs don't match. Start again.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.subtitle: Add a CointMU token by its contract address, or hide tokens you don't use.
tokens.unverifiedBody: Anyone can create a token with any name or symbol. Only add tokens you trust, and check the contract address with the project that issued it.
tokens.empty: No tokens yet. Add one with its contract address.

errors.invalidAddress: That isn't a valid contract address.
errors.badChecksum: This address has a typo (its capital letters don't match). Check it and try again.
errors.alreadyAdded: This token is already in your list.
errors.notContract: There is no contract at this address on CointMU.
errors.notToken: This contract doesn't look like a token (no symbol or decimals).
errors.network: Can't reach the CointMU network right now. Try again.
